name: swift-demo
description: Full Swift storefront demo on the split composition (Swift 2.4): framework-only base + the surface-swift content surface (en-US area + UrlPath + own item types) + six feature layers (feature-reordering + feature-pricing — the P3 split of the retired feature-reordering-pricing — plus feature-rma, feature-subscription-orders, feature-bom-configurator, and feature-b2b-comms — the B2B dealer email pack + onboarding flow) + sample data, proven on the default theme. From the v5 phase-2 baseline it also composes truvio-demo@1.0.0, the Truvio Commerce brand catalogue (16 groups, 60 masters + 36 variant rows, 12 orders, three personas): sample-data keeps the gate's marker-string fixtures and rides the sampleData toggle, truvio-demo carries the rows a prospect sees and is named in add[] like any other addition. base-swift composes neither. Proven on DW 10.28.1-PreRelease.
